title: Filtering API Results with Query Parameters
instructions: Use `requests.get()` and the `params` dictionary to filter a public API to retrieve a specific set of comments.
steps: Define the base URL for the API endpoint: `https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/comments`.
Define a Python dictionary named `filter_params` to filter the results. Set the key `postId` to the value `7`.
Make a GET request to the base URL, passing `filter_params` to the `params` argument. Store the response in `r`.
Print the full URL that was generated by the `requests` library using `r.url`.
Print the content of the response using `r.text`.
starterCode:
import requests

base_url = 'https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/comments'

# 1. Define the parameters dictionary
filter_params = {
    'postId': 7
}

# 2. Make the GET request with the parameters
r = requests.get(base_url, params=filter_params)

# 3. Print the generated URL
print(f"Generated URL: {r.url}")

# 4. Print the raw content
print(r.text)
solution:
import requests

base_url = 'https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/comments'

# 1. Define the parameters dictionary
filter_params = {
    'postId': 7
}

# 2. Make the GET request with the parameters
r = requests.get(base_url, params=filter_params)

# 3. Print the generated URL
print(f"Generated URL: {r.url}")

# 4. Print the raw content
print(r.text)
hints: The key to this exercise is the `params=` keyword argument in the `requests.get()` function.
The `requests` library automatically appends `?postId=7` to the base URL.
